title: Electric Router Machine/Hand Trimmer WOOD WORKING MACHINE
description:
Electric Router Machine/Hand Trimmer WOOD WORKING MACHINE
DESCRIPTIONS:

INPUT/OUTPUT :
200-240V- 50-60Hz
1800W 23000/Min
POWER CONNECTER : 3 PIN MALAYSIA SOCKET
Toggle Switch
Quick release depth adjustment
Reliable 1,650Wmotor
Ergonomic design contoured knob style handles with soft grip perfectly fit the operators hands for comfortable operation.
Shaft lock for easy bit changes
Lock lever fixes router head securely at a desired height
Quick release depth stopper fast setting of cut depth by pushing a button
